run.caveat: Results depend on the model. A different model, or the same model at a different temperature, will produce different numbers. These are measurements of one model's behaviour on this tool list, not a property of the server.

tools.name: get_rfo_agency_deviation
tools.description: Resolve an indexed source ID and return page-numbered official PDF text.

tools.name: get_rfo_guidance
tools.description: Return an allowlisted Acquisition.gov RFO FAQ or guidance resource.

tools.name: get_rfo_part
tools.description: Return parsed, paginated model-deviation text for one FAR part.

tools.name: list_rfo_agency_deviations
tools.description: List official agency-deviation links discovered through the RFO index.

tools.name: list_rfo_parts
tools.description: List official RFO model parts and counts of posted agency deviations.
